cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: I Can Handle This
cards.instruction: Perform complete emotional readiness while quietly borrowing coping strategies from every response around you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm completely prepared for this rejection email. Why have you brought water?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Small sips helped when I lost my job.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My approach exactly. Leave the jug; I prefer a thorough preparation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I had my sister read the email aloud. Want me to?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, that's why you're here. Start gently.

reason: Remove repeated system explanation; retroactive assignment makes the confident appropriation visible and leaves a useful reader instruction.
